```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Separate ACC from the other measures
dat_long_rt <- dat_c %>%
  select(participant, mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure,
    "mean_T_encode"    = "T_encode",
    "mean_RT_onset"    = "RT_onset",
    "mean_RT_critical" = "RT_critical"
  ))

dat_long_acc <- dat_c %>%
  select(participant, mean_ACC) %>%
  mutate(mean_ACC = mean_ACC * 100)  # convert to percent

# Calculate the mean and SD
summary_rt  <- dat_long_rt %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE))

summary_acc <- dat_long_acc %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(mean_ACC, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd   = sd(mean_ACC,   na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(measure = "ACC")

# Bar chart
bar_rt <- ggplot(summary_rt, aes(x = measure, y = mean, fill = measure)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Time (s)", sec.axis = sec_axis(
    ~ . / max(summary_rt$mean) * 100,
    name = "ACC (%)"
  )) +
  geom_bar(data = summary_acc, aes(x = measure, y = mean / 100 * max(summary_rt$mean)),
           stat = "identity", width = 0.6, fill = "#E69F00") +
  geom_errorbar(data = summary_acc,
                aes(x = measure,
                    y = mean / 100 * max(summary_rt$mean),
                    ymin = (mean - sd) / 100 * max(summary_rt$mean),
                    ymax = (mean + sd) / 100 * max(summary_rt$mean)),
                width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bar Chart (Mean ± SD)", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#E69F00"),
        axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#E69F00"))

# Box plot
box_rt <- ggplot(dat_long_rt, aes(x = measure, y = value, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2) +
  scale_y_continuous(name = "Time (s)", sec.axis = sec_axis(
    ~ . / max(dat_long_rt$value, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
    name = "ACC (%)"
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(data = dat_long_acc %>% rename(value = mean_ACC) %>% mutate(
    measure = "ACC",
    value = value / 100 * max(dat_long_rt$value, na.rm = TRUE)
  ), aes(x = measure, y = value), fill = "#E69F00", width = 0.6) +
  labs(title = "Box Plot", x = "") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#E69F00"),
        axis.text.y.right  = element_text(color = "#E69F00"))

# Arrange side by side
bar_rt + box_rt
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# RT-related measures
dat_long_rt <- dat_cc %>%
  select(participant, mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(mean_T_encode, mean_RT_onset, mean_RT_critical),
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(measure = recode(measure,
    "mean_T_encode"    = "T_encode",
    "mean_RT_onset"    = "RT_onset",
    "mean_RT_critical" = "RT_critical"
  ))

# Calculate the mean and SD
summary_rt <- dat_long_rt %>%
  group_by(measure) %>%
  summarise(mean = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE))

# Bar chart
bar_rt <- ggplot(summary_rt, aes(x = measure, y = mean, fill = measure)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd), width = 0.2) +
  labs(title = "Bar Chart (Mean ± SD)", x = "", y = "Time (s)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Box plot
box_rt <- ggplot(dat_long_rt, aes(x = measure, y = value, fill = measure)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = 16, outlier.size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Box Plot", x = "", y = "Time (s)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Arrange side by side
bar_rt + box_rt
```
